authorized_by: PI, after Confirmation A scoring returned gate3 BLOCKED

this_is_not_a_replication.it_is: a deterministic REPLAY to recover episode-level records that the frozen Gate 3 estimator requires and the evaluator failed to persist
this_is_not_a_replication.it_is_not: Confirmation A v2, a rerun hoping for a better outcome, or a new sample
this_is_not_a_replication.naming_rule: refer to this as CONFIRMATION_A_EPISODE_ROW_RECOVERY. Never as 'Confirmation A v2'.
this_is_not_a_replication.why_it_is_legitimate: evaluation is deterministic given (checkpoint, opponent, seed). Every input is byte-identical to the original run; the only difference is that per-episode rows are written to disk instead of discarded.

the_defect_being_repaired.what_happened: run_crossplay_eval.py built `all_rows` in memory and wrote only per-cell aggregates. Block 9300000 therefore has win rates but no per-episode outcomes.
the_defect_being_repaired.why_it_blocks_gate3: SPECIALIST_PILOT_FROZEN.delta_pool_definition.SPLIT_HALF_ORACLE selects the per-opponent argmax AND the fixed comparator on half the episodes (by eval_seed parity) and scores both on the other half. Aggregates cannot be split.
the_defect_being_repaired.gate3_status_is_BLOCKED_not_FAIL: we do not have the data required to evaluate it. Writing gate3 = FAIL would misreport an engineering defect as a scientific result.

unchanged_from_the_original_run.checkpoints: the same five, verified by checkpoint_sha256 recorded in specialist_pilot_summary.json
unchanged_from_the_original_run.estimator: the already-frozen split-half oracle and AMENDMENT_1 symmetric V_fixed selection, unchanged

the_only_software_change.properties: additive and write-only. `all_rows` already existed in memory; no RNG, no policy load, no episode loop, and no aggregation path is touched.
the_only_software_change.consequence_if_it_were_not_write_only: the acceptance check below would detect it

output_isolation.rule: the recovery run writes to its OWN tag. It must not overwrite specialist_pilot_summary.json, which is the original evidence.

ACCEPTANCE_GATE.name: REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE
ACCEPTANCE_GATE.rule: for all 35 cells, the replayed per-cell win_rate must EXACTLY equal the original, and n must be 60
ACCEPTANCE_GATE.why_exact: deterministic evaluation on identical inputs must reproduce identical aggregates. Any tolerance would let a genuine behavioural change hide inside it.
ACCEPTANCE_GATE.on_mismatch: BLOCKED_REPLAY_MISMATCH -- do not score gate3, do not reinterpret, do not adjust the tolerance. A mismatch means the persistence patch was not write-only, or some input was not what we believe it was, and that must be diagnosed before any number from the replay is used.
ACCEPTANCE_GATE.doubles_as: an integrity test of the persistence patch itself

what_is_computed_only_after_the_acceptan: SPECIALIST_INCREMENTAL_VALUE (both mappings chosen on half A, per AMENDMENT_1)

what_is_NOT_recomputed.gate1: FAIL, already scored on the original run -- LCB95 -.128
what_is_NOT_recomputed.gate2: FAIL, already scored on the original run -- LCB95 -.275
what_is_NOT_recomputed.rule: Gate 1 and Gate 2 stand as originally scored. They need only per-cell proportions, which were never missing. Do not rescore or reinterpret them; the recovery adds Gate 3 and the attribution diagnostics and nothing else.
what_is_NOT_recomputed.artifact: the original CONFIRMATION_A_RESULT.json is not edited; Gate 3 lands in CONFIRMATION_A_GATE3_RESULT.json

scientific_result_unaffected.specialist_hypothesis: already FAILED and is not revisited. S_OP7 beats or ties S_OP8 on 7 of 7 opponents; gate2 fails on direction alone.
scientific_result_unaffected.do_not_rerun: the 1M-step specialist TRAINING runs. Those have spoken. Only the deterministic evaluation is replayed.

why_gate3_still_matters_after_the_specia.question_gate3_answers: does the five-policy population contain useful held-out repertoire value at all, and which policies carry it?
why_gate3_still_matters_after_the_specia.if_PASS: the specialist experiment failed while the VGC population still uncovered a useful repertoire -- the selected policies become candidate latent teachers
why_gate3_still_matters_after_the_specia.if_FAIL: even the full five-policy population lacks sufficient selective value, which strengthens the case for the VGC-4 gauntlet
why_gate3_still_matters_after_the_specia.confirmation_B_cannot_answer_it: B evaluates two policies, so V_fixed over the five-policy set is undefined on block 9200000

scheduling.must_not_interrupt: Confirmation B, currently running on block 9200000
scheduling.launch_condition: Confirmation B complete AND scored AND the GPU free
